title: Juicy Roasted Greek Potato Stir-fry
description: This savory and juicy Greek potato dish is perfect for a hangover cure. Made with small potatoes roasted to perfection and tossed in a flavorful olive oil based sauce, this dish offers a light, satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: small potatoes
ingredients.notes: preferably Yukon Gold or Red potatoes

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: extra virgin for best flavor and health benefits

ingredients.name: oregano
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp dried or 2 tbsp fresh, chopped
ingredients.notes: for added flavor and hangover relief

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: adjust to preference, especially if not using smoked or sea salt

ingredients.name: fresh lemon juice
ingredients.notes: for a burst of acidity and freshness

instructions: Wash the potatoes thoroughly and prick them with a fork all over.
Place the potatoes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Drizzle with olive oil, add minced garlic, oregano, red pepper flakes, salt, and lemon juice evenly across each potato.
Bake in preheated oven for 25-30 minutes or until potatoes are tender and slightly charred on the outside.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes. Slice into wedges if desired for easier eating.
Garnish with additional fresh oregano and serve immediately.
